application_policy: GOMEMLIMIT, application code, restart policy and workloads stay identical in all four histories. GOMEMLIMIT is intentionally not retuned when a cgroup cap changes. Memory effects can include reclaim, queuing and OOM; no mechanism is presumed.
memory_swap: For checkout and ad, HostConfig.MemorySwap equals HostConfig.Memory and cgroup memory.swap.max equals 0 at every live snapshot.
runtime_checks: Inspect all controlled HostConfig values and live cpu.max, memory.max and memory.swap.max before and after every measured epoch. A stopped/restarting SUT container with the correct persisted configuration is a system-failure diagnostic, not a quota exclusion. Unreadable cgroups on an otherwise stable live container are instrumentation-invalid. Read memory.current and memory.events with PID/container identity; never difference counters across identities.
